name: SSD1306 OLED 128x64
description: Solomon Systech SSD1306 — monochrome 128×64 OLED display, I2C interface. Driven with U8g2 library.

alternatives.how: Bridge SA0 solder jumper on breakout board to select 0x3D

notes: 3.3V device. Most breakout boards accept 3.3–5V supply but the logic is 3.3V — safe to connect directly to ESP32. Default I2C address is 0x3C; some modules hard-wire 0x3D. Use U8g2 constructor U8G2_SSD1306_128X64_NONAME_F_HW_I2C or the page-buffer variant to save RAM.
